sourceModel.description: Mirage 2000-5 aerodynamic data generated with VSPAERO, plus aircraft-specific M53-P2 propulsion and flight-control systems.

packagingChanges: The canonical model id and filename are changed to mirage2000-open-data for qttest discovery.
Only files required by the headless JSBSim runtime are included; FlightGear graphics, cockpit display controls, weapons, pushback, cockpit-driven hydraulics, scripts and audio are excluded.
A qttest packaging note and version suffix are added to the original aircraft file header.
FlightGear-provided external-tank and point-mass drag properties default to zero so the clean aircraft configuration runs in standalone JSBSim.
The CFYDRD table declaration is corrected from an invalid three-axis form to the two axes represented by its unchanged source data: angle of attack and rudder deflection.
FlightGear cockpit control inputs used by the FCS are mapped to native JSBSim command and angular-rate properties.
External fuel tanks and the FlightGear-dependent transfer system are excluded; the eight source internal tanks feed the engine directly.
knownLimitations: The model is experimental and is not certified or representative of classified aircraft data.

The VSPAERO reference geometry in the source FDM uses aerodynamic reference dimensions that differ from published full-aircraft manufacturer dimensions; changing those values without regenerating coefficient tables would invalidate force scaling.
Mass properties, control laws, propulsion tables and fuel-system behavior require independent validation across the full envelope.
The standalone package assumes both hydraulic control circuits are serviceable; hydraulic failures and cockpit pump controls are not simulated.
Internal fuel feed order and transfer behavior are simplified for standalone operation and require dedicated fuel-system validation.
The M53-P2 thrust tables use documented engineering assumptions and NASA-derived normalized trends described in the engine source header.
External stores, damage, terrain interaction and operational avionics fidelity are outside this package's validation scope.
